Require exact eligible device rows and bytes for the PLE model, mixed-host near case, short cache-window switch and ragged 8208-row resumed suffix. Stop at first failed gate.
plan.scope: Instrumented native correctness. Clean throughput and physical final slot tested separately.

providers.source: glibc constructors;not speed or hardware utilization

plan.unit: Hoist two BF16 P fragments across four ordered-exp PV output tiles. Keep V staging, FP32 alpha scaling, per-output MAD order and both barriers.
plan.build: Only the separate component targets. Preserve and recheck every parent binary.
plan.smoke: Traced cap33 gather on both actual exports. Parameter validation, checked closure, positional guards and exact output bits precede full numerical coverage.
plan.numeric: Eleven cases including cap1/17/31/32/33/63/65/2051, full 262144 addresses, padded heads, invalid scales and scratch refusal. Match complete BF16 output and FP32 state against the original ordered-exp kernel.
plan.timing: Three fresh processes, three shapes with 78453 live cells and 8192 queries. Six alternated pairs per shape, including admission, pack, compute and drain. Reset output outside timing. Floors 0.5 ms cap33 and 10 ms cap2051. Native steady_clock overhead median <1 us and p99 <5 us.
plan.decision: Require lower median time in all three processes per shape. Both cap2051 patterns must win to try that cap in a separate model plan. Retain the reference at cap33 unless that shape independently passes. Other caps, model speed, physical traffic and register spills remain unqualified.
plan.retention: Keep the two fixtures through the component decision and machine-code inspection, then retire them under the parent build policy.

artifact_retirement.decision: Component and embedded SPIR-V inspection closed. Preserve original timings, executable identities and bounds in Git. The same-model fixture, engine and independent decode reference remain available for BF16 and decode work.
removed: the two sycl_qsa_prefill_pv_{test,bench} executables and three trial-only objects specified by the verified build record

plan.unit: Compare all four input/output choices. Use ordinary SYCL expert copies, including on the standalone 512-slot allocation for a host tail.
plan.extent: First 16385 input/4 output in each arm. Then 262144 input, 262143 batched rows, checked refill of the final slot, zero output in each arm.
plan.acceptance: Verify actual host/device split, layer receipts, QSA scratch, identical work, post-release marker, normal exit and no new driver fault. Stop at first refusal or error. This is standalone capacity evidence.

plan.acceptance: Compare second/third prompt-time medians in four complete blocks. Separate input-only, output-only, combined and both incremental contrasts. A contrast requires four ratios below one. Keep TTFT and 1000 PP separate.
plan.fixed: Same native binary and ordinary384; exact historical bodies, MoE work, draft counts, copy byte totals and placement; 24 tokens with thinking on.
plan.stop: First workload, route, validation, ownership, fault or budget failure. Retain every eligible time; no speed-based stopping or cohort replacement.

providers.source: glibc constructors;not speed or hardware utilization

plan.interval: Wall time from first host call through the final checked event on the in-order compute queue. Compare scalar production mixed gather plus native fused GU with mapped native GU. Fix W, bank, source map, DPAS geometry, B loading, precision and output bytes in each pair. The model dispatcher, dequantization and all other layers are outside this component interval.
plan.order: Rotate shape order by two per process. Start with (process+shape_index)%2, then alternate arm order per pair. Arm 0 is gather plus native GU; arm 1 is mapped GU.
plan.repeat: After exact warmed checks, eight calls in each pilot. Use the same repeat count for the pair, ceil(target_ms*pilot_repeats/min(pilot_ms)), within [1,repeat_cap]. Minimum eligible duration applies to both arms of every pair. Keep all short batches with performance eligibility false for the affected workload. No replacement.
plan.timer: Maximum mean of three windows of 4096 back-to-back steady_clock pairs must be at most 0.1% of the minimum eligible duration. Apply no time subtraction.
plan.validation: Trace a fresh two-case smoke on the relinked fixture. Time separate unprofiled fresh processes. Before timing each shape, check gather oracle, BF16 and FP16 captures, no-capture outputs and guards. Check warmed output bits, status and output guards after each timed batch. Resets and checks are outside the clock.
plan.advance: For a layout at a given size, require complete eligible batches and at least two of three process medians of paired mapped/gather ratios below one with four of six paired wins each. The aggregate paired median must also be below one. Both layouts must pass to consider that size for route review. This is component evidence only.
plan.retention: Reuse the admitted operator device and host objects. Keep the latest comparison fixture and compact samples until the component decision. Preserve the model prefill and decode references.

plan.compare: Three independent AB, BA, AB pairs on the stock 1256-slot decode placement. A uses reload and scalar gather. B uses the KV reuse and vec8 combination selected at 65537 fresh inputs. The same executable runs official long, six-turn agent and both v5 thinking workloads in each process. The 65K prefill-only screen is separate.
plan.decision: Use the maintained full-suite preservation gates. Require actual matched long-prompt work and dispatch, observed MTP classes, matching agent request bodies and work counts for the decode preservation decision. Report all paired rates, PP, client TTFT and MTP acceptance. Different output work remains workload throughput evidence. Model adoption and physical final-slot coverage are separate.
plan.stop: Stop on wrong inputs or dispatch, incomplete execution, ownership, budget or runtime fault. Keep every completed pair with no speed-based stopping, replacement or automatic adoption.
